name: Team Charmander: Hyper-Offense & Aerial Supremacy
archetype: Fire/Grass dual STAB, Intimidate dragon dance sweeps, and electric wallbreaking.
gym_duel_rationale: The Indigo Plateau gauntlet tests full tactical depth across 5 consecutive battles: Charizard/Venusaur melts Lorelei's Ice types and counters Bruno's Fighting squad; Gyarados/Nidoking blunts physical sweepers with Intimidate and sets up Dragon Dance to sweep; Alakazam/Raichu outspeeds Lorelei's Water bulks with Thunderbolt and breaks Agatha with Psychic; Primeape/Sandslash breaks Steel and Normal walls with Close Combat and Earthquake; Snorlax sponges special blasts from Mew and Agatha's ghosts; and Lapras freezes Lance's Flying/Dragon squad with Ice Beam.

roster.progression_notes: 530 BST Fire/Grass powerhouse. Resists Fighting, Grass, and Fairy moves. Incinerates Lorelei's Ice types and melts Bruno's Steelix with Flamethrower.
522 BST physical pivot. Intimidate cuts opponent Attack on entry. Sets up Dragon Dance and washes away Ground and Fire threats.
500 BST speed demon with 120 SpA. Thunderbolt electrocutes Lorelei's Water tanks and Lance's Gyarados, while Psychic shreds Bruno's fighters.
477 BST wallbreaker. Vital Spirit prevents Sleep. Swords Dance-boosted Close Combat and Earthquake demolish Bruno's Steelix and Agatha's Snorlax.
Colossal 160 HP tank. Sponges special hits from Mew and Agatha's Ghost team. Rest + Sleep Talk guarantees team longevity across the gauntlet.
535 BST Water/Ice wall. Ice Beam cleanly obliterates Lance's Dragonite, Aerodactyl, and Altaria hybrids. Water Absorb pivots on Lorelei's Water moves.

flex_bench.rationale: High-Speed Flying pivot providing Tailwind speed control and Roost.
Levitate Ground immunity and high physical Defense with Sludge Bomb.
Iron Fist boosts Thunder Punch and Ice Punch for flexible tech coverage.
